blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mobile network services at major bus terminals across Metro Manila were generally reliable during this year’s Undas travel rush, according to the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC). This follows the NTC’s directive to telco firms to ensure reliable service during the Undas travel period, particularly in areas with anticipated high public activity and mobile network traffic. READ: Telcos brace for NTC penalty over ‘poor mobile broadband signals’ In a statement over the weekend, the regulator said nearly 90 percent of its mobile broadband tests recorded download speeds of at least 50 megabits per second (Mbps).
